title: Error Atlas: multi-dimensional failure taxonomy and response-classification pipeline
creator: Anika Patel
description:
Motivation: current error dashboards are siloed (http codes, model errors, timeouts) and make it hard to diagnose cross-cutting failure modes (e.g., transient overload that looks like model errors). This ticket builds an "Error Atlas": a multidimensional taxonomy + a small pipeline that classifies responses into remediation buckets and surfaces them in a pivotable dashboard. The atlas will be used for alerting, incident Triage, and automated rollback/circuit-fallback policies.

Goals:
- Define a compact taxonomy (origin, symptom, signature, severity, remediation) that covers timeouts, overload/backpressure, model faults (OOM/segfault/invalid-output), transport errors (HTTP/gRPC codes), and infra failures (disk, OOM killer).
- Instrument tracing hooks and enrich logs to produce the attributes needed for classification.
- Build a classification pipeline (lightweight stream job) that tags traces/spans and emits aggregated metrics and example traces to a Grafana/Loki dashboard.
- Provide alerting recipes mapped to SLO impact and suggested first-response steps for on-call playbooks.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Taxonomy doc published and approved by Oncall + SRE + ModelOps; 2) Tracing library adds 5 new attributes (redwood.failure_origin, redwood.failure_signature, redwood.remediation_hint, redwood.model_variant, redwood.kv_cache_hit) propagated through service-to-service calls; 3) Pipeline emits a daily 'error_atlas' metric series with cardinality bounded (<200 tags) and a Grafana board with pivots for origin/symptom/severity; 4) Three alert rules created (timeout spike, overload-induced error-rate, model-failure regression) with runbook links; 5) Example DR scenario validated on staging (simulated overload reproduces classification and alert).
implementation_notes:
Taxonomy draft (first pass):
- origin: client | edge | runtime | model | infra
- symptom: timeout | overload | model-exception | invalid-response | transport-4xx | transport-5xx | rpc-cancel | backpressure | resource-oom
- signature: short string fingerprint constructed from span sequence (eg: 'kv-lookup->router->infer:timeout-200ms').
- severity: minor | major | critical (mapped to customer_impact).
- remediation_hint: retry-client | increase-concurrency | scale-dedicated | rollback-model | throttle-source | investigate-node

Instrumentation checklist: add OpenTelemetry attributes on request entry and at model-serving boundary: redwood.request_id, redwood.model_variant, redwood.seq_len, redwood.kv_cache_hit, redwood.batch_size, redwood.backend_latency_ms, redwood.failure_origin (if error), redwood.failure_signature. Ensure attributes propagate through async job workers.

Classification pipeline: lightweight Flink/stream job or ksql job that consumes trace-span-topic and error-log-topic, computes signature heuristics, assigns taxonomy labels, emits aggregated metrics to metrics-topic and example trace references to 'error-atlas-examples' index. Keep retention short for examples (7d).

Sample Loki query for dashboard example: 
{job=~"runtime.*"} | json | failure_signature!="" | unwrap timestamp | count_over_time(1m) by (failure_signature, failure_origin)

Suggested alert (P0):
- name: Runtime overload spikes causing 5xx/error-rate
- expr: sum(rate(error_atlas{symptom="overload"}[5m])) / sum(rate(requests_total[5m])) > 0.02 AND p95(latency_ms[5m]) > 750
- runbook: scale-dedicated -> notify-sre -> enable-fallback-to-variant-B

Dashboard UX: pivot rows by origin, columns by symptom, heatmap cell = 5m error-rate * recent-traffic-factor. Drilldown to top example traces and sample logs.

Performance constraints: aggregated metric cardinality must be capped. Use coalescing rules in pipeline (map similar signatures to family ids).
comments_updates: 2025-02-19: Kickoff sync with SRE, ModelOps, Runtime; agreed to keep classification stage external to core runtime to reduce risk.
2025-02-22: Decided on initial attribute set - Mateo will open PR in opentelemetry-instrumentation repo for runtime SDK. Blocking: need trace-topic schema change approved by infra data team.
2025-02-25: Prototype classification job implemented in ksql; produces family_id for signatures and emits to metrics topic. Early results show top-3 families cover 62% of errors in 24h sample.
2025-02-28: UX review with Product — want quick 'suggested action' button on each cell linking to runbook and PR to rollback model. Design asked for sample-size indicator for statistical confidence.

2025-03-03: Staging run-through: simulated model OOM (inject env var) produced correct classification as model-exception and triggered the model-failure alert. Follow-up: add jittered retry suppression to avoid alert storms.
next_steps: 1) Merge OTel attribute PR and deploy to canary (Mateo) 2) Finish classification ksql job and add coalescing rules to cap cardinality (Datainfra) 3) Create Grafana board with pivot widgets and link runbooks (Monitoring) 4) Add alert rules to alerting repo and runbook pages (SRE).
notes_for_oncall: When a heatmap cell turns red: check example traces attached; look for KV-cache hit rate and batch_size anomalies; if origin=model -> attempt variant rollback; if origin=infra -> run node diagnostics and check autoscale logs. Use 'suggested action' buttons on dashboard to execute common runbook steps.
